Case A: The allergy field is blank, and staff convert it to 'no known allergies' without asking the patient or checking available information.

Case B: The pharmacy stores a REMS authorization in the patient chart and assumes no separate counseling or dispensing records are needed.

Which proposed interpretation is INCORRECT? Select ONE answer.

A.original_option_text: The pharmacy must make the described reasonable effort to obtain relevant profile information.

Case A: An oral contraceptive is dispensed in the community without the applicable patient package insert because the patient received one with an earlier package.

Case B: An LTCF continues the applicable therapy and assumes the community package workflow is the only patient-information timing rule to consider.

Which conclusion correctly addresses Case A? Select ONE answer.

A.original_option_text: Every estrogen-containing product is governed by an identical PPI provision regardless of product type.

authorities.version: eCFR current text up to date as of 10/30/2026;retrieved2026-11-03
eCFR current text up to date as of 10/30/2026;retrieved2026-11-03

A.original_rationale_ko:
선택하지 않아야 하는 잘못된 설명. §310.501과 §310.515의 적용 제품을 확인한다.
교정된 설명: Estrogen-progestogen oral contraceptives follow the specified oral-contraceptive provision rather than being indiscriminately reassigned.

B.original_option_text: The PPI's 30-day interval establishes the prescription's refill validity.

authorities.version: eCFR current text up to date as of 10/30/2026;retrieved2026-11-03

교정된 설명: The PPI information clock is separate from prescription refill validity.

C.original_option_text: The applicable PPI accompanies each dispensed oral-contraceptive package.

authorities.version: eCFR current text up to date as of 10/30/2026;retrieved2026-11-03

C.original_rationale_ko: 선택해야 하는 옳은 설명. 해당 oral contraceptive의 각 dispensed package에 PPI를 함께 제공한다.

D.original_option_text: The institutional pathway has no first-administration or continuing 30-day information requirement.

authorities.version: eCFR current text up to date as of 10/30/2026;retrieved2026-11-03

D.original_rationale_ko:

교정된 설명: The institutional rule includes provision before first administration and every 30 days while therapy continues.

Case A: A Massachusetts pharmacy declines to offer counseling to a cash-paying patient because the federal Medicaid DUR provisions concern Medicaid beneficiaries.

Case B: A mail-service prescription includes written information, and staff treat the leaflet as proof that all applicable counseling access requirements have been satisfied.

Which conclusion correctly addresses Case A? Select ONE answer.

A.original_option_text: The terms offer, counseling, and refusal identify the same event for legal records.

authorities.version: Massachusetts Register1536, publication/footer2024-12-06

A.original_rationale_ko:
선택하지 않아야 하는 잘못된 설명. 제공 제안·실제 설명·환자 거절은 각각 사실에 맞게 기록한다.
교정된 설명: Offer, actual counseling, and documented refusal describe different events.

B.original_option_text: Massachusetts's independent counseling obligations are not confined to Medicaid payment.

authorities.version: Massachusetts Register1536, publication/footer2024-12-06
eCFR current text up to date as of 10/30/2026;retrieved2026-11-03

C.original_option_text: Enclosing a leaflet conclusively satisfies all mail-service counseling requirements.

authorities.version: Massachusetts Register1536, publication/footer2024-12-06

교정된 설명: Written information alone does not establish compliance with every applicable mail-service counseling requirement.

D.original_option_text: Completing prospective review removes the need for all patient-information and counseling duties.

authorities.version: Massachusetts Register1536, publication/footer2024-12-06

D.original_rationale_ko:
선택하지 않아야 하는 잘못된 설명. 한 단계의 완료가 다른 단계의 의무를 자동 면제하지 않는다.
